en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of workers outdoors in a quarry- or hillside-like setting. They stand in a semicircle with large wooden wheelbarrows in front of them. The men wear hats and simple work clothes. Above the image is printed text, and below there is printed greeting text in red plus handwritten cursive text covering the lower half of the card.
